atoms.name: Factorising a joint distribution
atoms.one_line: $P(X_1,\dots,X_n)=\prod_iP(X_i\mid\text{parents}(X_i))$; each factor is one CPT entry.

atoms.name: Conditional independence and d-separation
atoms.one_line: Chain and fork: observing the middle blocks. Collider: observing it (or a descendant) opens.

atoms.name: CPTs and parameter counting
atoms.one_line: A binary node with $k$ binary parents needs $2^k$ numbers; a BN needs far fewer than $2^n-1$.

atoms.name: Variable elimination
atoms.one_line: Multiply the factors that mention a variable, sum it out, repeat; exact; cost set by the largest factor.

atoms.name: Sampling methods
atoms.one_line: Rejection and likelihood weighting are approximate; Gibbs is MCMC; variable elimination is exact.

atoms.name: Probability toolkit
atoms.one_line: Marginalisation, Bayes' rule, conditional independence $P(X\mid Y,Z)=P(X\mid Z)$.

atoms.name: Markov blanket
atoms.one_line: Parents, children and the children's other parents shield a node from the rest of the network.
